title: Holding Company IO Reconciliation with Three-Name Advertiser Entity
question: The finance team flags a $45K discrepancy between the IO value ($380K) and revenue recognized in GAM ($334,700). Before issuing a make-good or credit, what must ad ops determine first?

contributor.name: Natasha Williams
contributor.title: Ad Operations Director
contributor.domain_expertise: Programmatic deal reconciliation, advertiser entity management, IO interpretation, cross-platform attribution, make-good decisions

choices: Whether Omnicom Media Group, PHD Media, and Nestlé USA are separate contractual entities requiring independent reconciliation
Whether Marcus's thumbs-up emoji in Slack constitutes an authorized make-good commitment that Prism must now honor

Whether the $45K gap is a pacing issue (campaign still has 22 days remaining) versus a structural delivery failure — since the pacing report projects $361K end-of-flight, the actual shortfall is ~$18.8K, not $45K
Whether the IO frequency cap (3x/user/day across all creatives) was violated — making this Prism's trafficking error requiring a make-good for the full $45K underdelivery
